name: Demo providers
description: One card per provider that works with a zero-sign-up demo key or no key at all, on the openbb-docker v3.0.1 stack: EIA, Congress.gov, BLS, CFTC, EconDB and Alpha Vantage (historical EPS, IBM only -- the point is that the call goes through and the table renders, not the symbol). Widget ids confirmed 2026-09-24 against a booted od v3.0.1 stack's own /widgets.json (Task 6 step 7). The Video Library card (v3.2.0) is openbb-api's own YouTube widget, the openbb-videos extension, and needs no key; its id comes from that extension's own widgets.json build on OpenBB 5.0.0, not from a booted stack. The BLS card uses bls_search (category=cpi, query=CUUR0000SA0), not bls_series: BLS's own HTTP API needs no key for either fetcher, but openbb-bls's BlsSeriesFetcher never overrides the base Fetcher class's require_credentials=True the way BlsSearchFetcher does, so bls_series 400s on this stack's blank BLS_API_KEY -- bls_search answers 200 with real data on first import, which is the point of this dashboard.
